ValidationRule.description: #19450 : Account Hierarchy: Opportunity should always be linked to an account where Hierarchy level is Sales (Site) #27029 : Adding bypass for upsells #20754: Removing bypass for Upsells
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND(
NOT($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.Disable_VR__c && OR(ISBLANK($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c), CONTAINS($Setup.Metadata_Activation_Settings__c.SObject_API_Name__c, 'Opportunity'))),
OR( ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(AccountId) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Account.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c))), NOT(ISPICKVAL(Account.IM_Hierarchy_Level__c ,'Sales (Site)')) ), $RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'CPQ_Sales_Opportunity', $RecordType.DeveloperName <> 'CPQ_Billing_Opportunity', NOT($Permission.VR_Bypass_Permission)
)
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please select a Sales (Site) Account for your Opportunity. Need help? Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner.
